access_requests_decided_by.name: access_requests_decided_by
access_requests_decided_by.value: "access_requests"."state" NOT IN ('approved', 'rejected', 'blocked') OR "access_requests"."decided_by" IS NOT NULL

issue_items_kind.name: issue_items_kind
issue_items_kind.value: ("issue_items"."source_point_id" IS NULL) = ("issue_items"."title" IS NOT NULL AND "issue_items"."body" IS NOT NULL)

issue_items_source.name: issue_items_source
issue_items_source.value: "issue_items"."source_point_id" IS NULL OR ("issue_items"."slot" IS NULL AND "issue_items"."persistence" = 'once' AND "issue_items"."lineage_id" = "issue_items"."source_point_id")

issue_items_title.name: issue_items_title
issue_items_title.value: "issue_items"."title" IS NULL OR char_length("issue_items"."title") BETWEEN 1 AND 300

point_events_note.name: point_events_note
point_events_note.value: "point_events"."note" IS NULL OR char_length("point_events"."note") BETWEEN 1 AND 2000

point_events_note_required.name: point_events_note_required
point_events_note_required.value: "point_events"."event" NOT IN ('return','reject') OR "point_events"."note" IS NOT NULL OR ("point_events"."event" = 'return' AND "point_events"."return_parts" IS NOT NULL)

point_events_return_parts.name: point_events_return_parts
point_events_return_parts.value: "point_events"."return_parts" IS NULL OR ("point_events"."event" = 'return' AND cardinality("point_events"."return_parts") BETWEEN 1 AND 5)

points_dates.name: points_dates
points_dates.value: "points"."end_date" IS NULL OR ("points"."event_date" IS NOT NULL AND "points"."end_date" >= "points"."event_date")

points_submitted_complete.name: points_submitted_complete
points_submitted_complete.value:
"points"."state" NOT IN ('submitted','approved','published')
        OR ("points"."title" <> '' AND "points"."earliest_monday" IS NOT NULL AND "points"."submitted_at" IS NOT NULL
            AND ("points"."kind" <> 'report' OR ("points"."event_date" IS NOT NULL AND "points"."opening" <> '')))

future_events_note.name: future_events_note
future_events_note.value: "future_events"."note" IS NULL OR char_length("future_events"."note") BETWEEN 1 AND 2000

future_events_note_required.name: future_events_note_required
future_events_note_required.value: "future_events"."event" NOT IN ('return','reject','refuse-cancel') OR "future_events"."note" IS NOT NULL OR ("future_events"."event" = 'return' AND "future_events"."return_parts" IS NOT NULL)

future_events_return_parts.name: future_events_return_parts
future_events_return_parts.value: "future_events"."return_parts" IS NULL OR ("future_events"."event" = 'return' AND cardinality("future_events"."return_parts") BETWEEN 1 AND 5)

future_items_dates.name: future_items_dates
future_items_dates.value: "future_items"."end_date" IS NULL OR ("future_items"."start_date" IS NOT NULL AND "future_items"."end_date" >= "future_items"."start_date")

future_items_submitted_complete.name: future_items_submitted_complete
future_items_submitted_complete.value:
"future_items"."state" NOT IN ('submitted','approved','cancelled')
        OR ("future_items"."title" <> '' AND "future_items"."start_date" IS NOT NULL AND "future_items"."submitted_at" IS NOT NULL)

report_placeholders_not_empty.name: report_placeholders_not_empty
report_placeholders_not_empty.value: "report_placeholders"."paragraph" IS NOT NULL OR "report_placeholders"."confirmed_original" IS NOT NULL

registry_entries_lengths.name: registry_entries_lengths
registry_entries_lengths.value: char_length("registry_entries"."given_name") BETWEEN 1 AND 60 AND char_length("registry_entries"."family_name") BETWEEN 1 AND 60 AND char_length("registry_entries"."class_code") BETWEEN 1 AND 8

registry_entries_archived.name: registry_entries_archived
registry_entries_archived.value: "registry_entries"."archived_year" IS NULL OR ("registry_entries"."removed_at" IS NOT NULL AND "registry_entries"."archived_year" ~ '^[0-9]{4}/[0-9]{4}$')

registry_lists_lengths.name: registry_lists_lengths
registry_lists_lengths.value: char_length("registry_lists"."title") BETWEEN 1 AND 120 AND char_length("registry_lists"."doc_label") BETWEEN 1 AND 300

generated_documents_pdf.name: generated_documents_pdf
generated_documents_pdf.value: ("generated_documents"."pdf_status" = 'ready') = ("generated_documents"."pdf" IS NOT NULL AND "generated_documents"."pdf_sha256" IS NOT NULL AND "generated_documents"."pdf_at" IS NOT NULL)
